labels.tip: The 1.35 mm EO section, its CPW and the 1 x 2 MMI lie to the left

notes: Same gold layer as the CPW, so the wire is 900 nm thick and has to be long: four passes of the 0.75 mm section (Methods). Fig. 1(c) shows two neighbouring modulators; the pads of the next device below the dummy are not drawn.

Honeycomb lines in the cladding are in the micrograph; the paper does not say what they are, so they are dashed in a neutral material. Their phase is not matched and they are left out near the wires; the micrograph runs them up to the waveguide clearing.
Dummy band is narrower than the heater band in the micrograph (7.6 against 13.5 um), though Fig. 1(b) draws them alike. Three bars is the reading at 2 um/px: dashed.
